decisions.reason: The inbound SMS API runs on the firm's existing messaging infrastructure, so keeping it costs little, and nothing adverse has shown up, so the option stays open while its value becomes clearer.
The email-to-SMS gateway was launched only in 2024 and links the firm's established email and messaging channels at low marginal cost, so its uncertain prospects favor keeping it.
The SMS-to-email gateway complements Products A and B on shared infrastructure and has had too little time on the market to show its value, so abandoning it now would be premature.
